items.label: sedimentary layers
items.quote: The law of original horizontality says that sedimentary layers are deposited in horizontal layers.

items.label: older rocks are on the bottom
items.quote: The law of superposition says that older rocks are on the bottom and younger rocks are on the top.

items.quote: The law of cross-cutting relationships says that something that cuts across a boundary must be younger than that boundary.

checks.message: every sort text length, id pattern and id uniqueness is within the frozen limits
all 6 item quote(s) appear verbatim in their cited source after whitespace normalisation (quotes-verbatim)

every item label occurs in its quote and every group label occurs in the quote or the same source paragraph (item-and-group-in-quote; the design discloses the weak-link false accept on long paragraphs — every quote is shown to the teacher)
every declared group is referenced by >= 2 items and every item groupId resolves (groups-covered)
every item has a distinct label after normalisation (distinct-items)
groups 3 (2-4) and items 6 (6-12) are within the frozen counts (counts-valid)
every number in group and item labels appears on the cited page or in the same quote (N-01) (numbers-checkable)
